relevance_note: Single-family report of four TNFAIP3 p.(Lys91*) carriers: "Here we describe a family with HA20 caused by a novel TNFAIP3 loss-of-function mutation".
method_note: Read the whole paper (no tables with patient data; supplements are figures and a primer table). Built JSON with a short Python script from hand-chosen values; all spans checked verbatim by script. Four in-scope people: II-1 (index), II-4, III-1 (daughter of index) and I-2 (mother of index, obligate carrier, not stated as genotyped and deceased). II-4's sex and relationship are not stated. I-2's variant row ties the family variant to her only via 'obligate carrier'; zygosity, type, pathogenicity and functional evidence left not reported for her. III-1 inheritance recorded as inherited maternal because the paper states the index (II-1, a woman) carries the variant and III-1 is her daughter. II-1 inheritance not reported (mother obligate carrier, not tested). Ages 30 and 8 years are ages at PBMC sampling (figure legends), recorded as age at last evaluation. III-1's age 4 years is age at JIA diagnosis, not HA20 diagnosis, so kept in the feature detail. Minor wording difference: figure 1 legend says 'severe autoinflammatory lung reaction', Results says 'severe inflammatory lung reaction'; not treated as a contradiction. Genital papillomatosis appears only in the figure legend. Checklist: 'articular symptoms' taken as arthritis or arthralgia; psoriasis taken as skin lesion; atrophic gastritis as GI inflammation; anaemia not stated autoimmune so cytopenia left not reported; lung reaction not called interstitial lung disease so left not reported. Plasma IL-18 elevation recorded for II-1 and III-1 (patients 1 and 2 in the supplementary figure 3 legend) as a group statement. Ex vivo PBMC cytokine results recorded only as functional evidence. No contradictions found.
